    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Account
    A brokerage/child account: the unit orders and holdings attach to/ A user can own more than one account (KAN-78, KAN-103/104) Represents an account with an ID, name, and balance.
    AccountExistsRequest
    Email submitted to check whether a business account already exists.
    AccountExistsResponse
    Result of the soft account existence check.
    AccountNotFoundException
    No account exists for the given account id.
    AccountRepository
    Repository interface for accessing Account entities.
    AccountStatusValidator
    The user who owns the account must be ACTIVE (KAN-86/92) — a deactivated trader shouldn't be able to place trades even if the request itself is otherwise well-formed.
    AuditTrail
    One row per order-lifecycle event.
    AuditTrailRepository
    Repository for accessing AuditTrail entities.
    AuditTrailService
    Appends one order-lifecycle event to the audit trail.
    AuthController
    REST endpoints for business account registration and the soft account existence check.
    AuthenticatedUser
    The caller identified by a verified access token.
    AuthService
    Creates business accounts for users already signed up with the auth service, and answers whether an email is already registered.
    CashTransaction
    One append-only cash movement (BR-09/14/15).
    CashTransactionRepository
    Repository for accessing CashTransaction entities.
    ConflictException
    Registration rejected because the account already has a profile, or the email is registered to another account.
    Fill
    The execution outcome of an ACCEPTED order (BR-06/08).
    FillRepository
    Repository for accessing Fill entities.
    ForbiddenException
    The authenticated caller is not allowed to perform the request, such as registering another account's email.
    GlobalExceptionHandler
    Translates controller exceptions and validation errors into HTTP error responses with an {"error": "..."} body.
    Holding
    Cached current quantity an account holds of one instrument.
    HoldingMovement
    One append-only position change caused by a fill (BR-09/14/15).
    HoldingMovementRepository
    Repository for accessing HoldingMovement entities.
    HoldingRepository
    Repository for accessing Holding entities.
    Instrument
    A tradable asset: equity, FX pair, or crypto.
    InstrumentNotFoundException
    No instrument exists for the given instrument id.
    InstrumentRepository
    Repository for accessing Instrument entities.
    Main
     
    MarketController
    Public, read-only endpoints for simulated stock snapshots, charts, and live ticks.
    MarketDataRepository
    Reads completed synthetic market sessions, candles, and replay ticks.
    MarketLimitException
    Indicates that a public market-data connection limit was reached.
    MarketReplayService
    Maintains shared simulation cursors and publishes bounded market-data responses.
    MarketRequestException
    Indicates invalid or unavailable market-data input.
    MarketResponses
    Public response records for the market-data API.
    MarketResponses.CalendarAvailability
    Available simulated market clock range for a replay session.
    MarketResponses.CandlePoint
    One aggregated OHLCV chart bucket.
    MarketResponses.CandleSeries
    Bounded chart history for one stock and timeframe.
    MarketResponses.ClockRequest
    Requested simulated market clock position.
    MarketResponses.Snapshot
    Complete ticker snapshot at one replay cursor.
    MarketResponses.StockSnapshot
    One stock's current price and session-relative movement.
    MarketResponses.TickEvent
    One synchronized live batch for a simulated market second.
    MarketResponses.TickPrice
    One stock price inside a synchronized live batch.
    MarketTimeframe
    Supported chart ranges and aggregation widths.
    MarketWebConfig
    Applies origin and request-rate safeguards to the public market API.
    Order
    A client's buy/sell instruction, tracked through its own status lifecycle (BR-04/05/06) — deliberately separate from execution, which lives in order.execution.Fill.
    OrderController
    REST endpoint for order submission (KAN-95, KAN-47).
    OrderExecutionService
    Turns an ACCEPTED order into a fill, atomically.
    OrderRepository
    Repository for accessing Order entities.
    OrderRequest
    A client's order submission (KAN-95 acceptance criterion: "acquire trading rules from the client").
    OrderResponse
    The outcome of a submitted order.
    OrderService
    Orchestrates one order submission: idempotency check, loading the entities the rule pipeline needs, running the pipeline, and — only if it passes — handing off to OrderExecutionService.
    OrderValidationPipeline
    Runs every registered OrderValidator in order and stops at the first rejection.
    OrderValidator
    One trading rule.
    RegisterRequest
    Profile details submitted by the registration form after the account has been created in the auth service.
    RegisterResponse
    Public profile returned after successful registration.
    SecurityConfig
    Configures the backend as an OAuth2 resource server that trusts access tokens issued by the NestJS auth service.
    SecurityErrorHandler
    Writes authentication (401) and authorization (403) failures from the security filter chain in the same {"error": "..."} format as GlobalExceptionHandler.
    SufficientFundsValidator
    BR-09/10: a BUY can't cost more than the account's cash balance.
    SufficientHoldingsValidator
    A SELL can't take a holding negative.
    TradabilityValidator
    BR-05: an order against an instrument that isn't open for trading is rejected.
    User
    A trader or admin's business account: profile, funds and account settings.
    UserController
    REST endpoints for the authenticated caller's own account.
    UserNotFoundException
    The authenticated caller has no business account yet, typically because registration was not completed.
    UserProfileResponse
    The caller's own business account.
    UserRepository
    Repository interface for accessing User entities.
    UserService
    Reads business accounts on behalf of their owners.
    ValidationResult
    The outcome of one OrderValidator check.
